paragraphs: The scrupulous people of Jerusalem. Mentioned in Sanhedrin 23a and 30a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: כג. ל.. is rendered 23a and 30a under the period convention. The doubled terminal stop is retained in the Hebrew rather than interpreted as a second folio side; no named edition is independently checked.
נקיי הדעת שבירושלים is a collective designation, rendered “the scrupulous people of Jerusalem.” Hyman gives only “mentioned” and the citations, without naming an individual.
